name: dsh-endfield-workbench
description: Endfield-inspired desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness
author: rison114514

scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:embedded-plugin && electron-packager . "DSH 终末地工作台" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extra-resource=.build-resources/endfield-ui-plugin
scripts.pack:mac:x64: npm run prepare:embedded-plugin && electron-packager . "DSH 终末地工作台" --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extra-resource=.build-resources/endfield-ui-plugin
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:embedded-plugin && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.sign:mac:local: codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/DSH 终末地工作台-darwin-arm64/DSH 终末地工作台.app" && codesign --verify --deep --strict "release/DSH 终末地工作台-darwin-arm64/DSH 终末地工作台.app"
